name: show-me
description: Explain the current topic visually with the smallest view that makes the point: pseudocode, a call tree, a component or file tree, a Mermaid diagram, a diff of the shape that changes, or one focused HTML page. Use when you ask to see the topic instead of reading about it ('show me', 'diagram this', /show-me), not for ordinary explanations. Ported from HumanLayer.
